requirements_summary: Workload: ticket summarization + agent-assist for mid-sized SaaS support team
Latency target: median <200ms for short summaries; 95p <500ms
Throughput: 50-100 reqs/min peak during working hours
Output: strict JSON schema for ticket fields; deterministic field extraction
Tooling: ability to call webhooks / tools to enrich tickets (billing lookup)
Cost sensitivity: wants guidance to reduce token spend (batching, caching)
poC_plan: 2-week hosted API POC. Week 1: integrate quickstart, run 2k summarizations, capture schema failure rate. Week 2: iterate prompts, add caching for repeated prefixes, measure avg token cost and latency. Deliverable: evaluation doc + go/no-go recommendation.
sales_notes: SMB inbound, strong product-led motion. Likely to stay on hosted API if costs align. Potential upsell to Dedicated if latency and spend justify reserved capacity. Owner to push pricing scenarios if schema pass rate >90%.
decision_criteria: structured output reliability >= 90% on sampled set; predictable cost per ticket < $0.02; latency SLOs met under representative load.
recent_risks: Early schema failures observed in edge-case technical tickets (stack traces). Customer wants a deterministic approach rather than probabilistic extraction.
